response.rationale: Unilateral progressive hardening with normal labs and absent inflammation fits morphea; CD34 positivity and lack of systemic features favor localized form over systemic sclerosis. Scleredema is excluded by negative Alcian blue and atypical location.

rejected.why: Alcian blue negative and unilateral thigh/buttock distribution are atypical for scleredema.
No joint symptoms or other features of fibroblastic rheumatism.
Normal autoantibodies and lack of systemic involvement argue against systemic sclerosis.
No renal history or gadolinium exposure; normal blood tests contradict NSF.
Location and lack of venous insufficiency make lipodermatosclerosis unlikely.
